2023-3499-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

719-6871-6879-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-6871-6879-8095.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat from step 3.

147-4452-6974.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Ashling's Command
147-4452-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Ashling's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4452-6974.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

147-1070-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-3899.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4694-4802-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-5147-7306.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat from step 1.

147-3899-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-3899-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3899-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3899-4302-5929.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

301-4381-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-3480.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-5241-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-5241-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-5241-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1263-2292-4871-4976.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

443-997-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-997-2946-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-5508--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

647-2366-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
647-2366-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

1479-2692-2841-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2692-2841-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

85-6994.description:
Activate Noctis's ability by paying {3}, exiling it.
Activate Vorpal Sword by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}.
During the declare attackers step, Noctis triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield tapped and attacking under your control, and causing it to be unblockable.
When Noctis enters, it triggers, attaching Vorpal Sword to it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Noctis. Vorpal Sword triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

147-1269-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1269-5147.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3875-4094-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-4094-5702-6973.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 4.

1365-1651-3967-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-3967-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

4567-6732.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 24 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 3.
4567-6732.description:
Activate Souldrinker by paying 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

1350-2079-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-2079-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

874-1170-6643.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Edgar this turn if Delif's Cone is in your graveyard.
874-1170-6643.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-6643.description:
Cast Delif's Cone from your hand or graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Edgar.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3470-5412-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
3470-5412-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger that many times.
Resolve all Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

1477-5263-6243.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Extruder abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

2034-2781-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding {2}.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

708-2438-2459-2500.description:
Pay {2} to Mirage Mirror to have it become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rograkh, returning Rograkh to the command zone.
When Rograkh enters the command zone, both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

1045-2034-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one red card in hand.
1045-2034-4424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Horde Ambusher, adding {C}{C}.
When Horde Ambusher dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Horde Ambusher from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Horde Ambusher's morph ability by revealing a red card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2034-5003-5205.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan, adding {C}{C}.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Glint-Sleeve Artisan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1283-2544-3094-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
1283-2544-3094-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {3}, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

654-774-1846-2137.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Islands.
654-774-1846-2137.description:
Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two Islands to your hand, copying High Tide.
Resolve the copy of High Tide.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two Islands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the Islands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping them.
Activate the Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Each High Tide that has resolved this turn triggers, adding {U}{U} for each trigger.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may instead use any other lands you control to get infinite mana those lands produce.
You may also target any other instant/sorcery on the stack using Uyo to create infinite copies of them.

372-2781-3603.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2781-3603.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve Abdel Adrian's enters-the-battlefield ability, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Felidar Guardian's enters-the-battlefield ability, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

2061-2793-4988.notablePrerequisites: Tamiyo's Compleation attached to Ugin's Nexus.
2061-2793-4988.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
